raw.title: Lantern Coast
raw.description: A living story on a fishing coast where the lanterns have started going out.

player.role: a newcomer who took a room above the harbour inn

living.premise: On a small fishing coast the harbour lanterns go out one by one each night, and nobody will say why. The harbourmaster, the innkeeper and a lighthouse keeper each know part of it.

qualities.rubric: How far does the harbourmaster trust the player, from 0 to 3?
Has the lighthouse been lit again?
Did the player press any local about the lanterns going out?

checkpoints.name: Toward The Second Lantern Fails
checkpoints.objective: Just after full dark, the second harbour lantern gutters and dies on its post, and a knot of fishermen on the quay stop talking the moment they notice who is watching. Maren crosses the boards toward them with a coil of rope and a face that says nothing is wrong.
